name: Lynne Liberato
tagline: Top rated Appellate attorney in Houston, Texas
education: South Texas College of Law Houston
about: Lynne Liberato is an attorney providing legal services covering Appellate, Business Litigation and General Litigation.

Lynne Liberato, who practices law in Houston, Texas, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2003 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at South Texas College of Law Houston. She graduated in 1980. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 1981.
